shortDescription: A modern overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools: a debug log that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them (stack + log-prefix + Harmony patch-owner attribution, a shipped known-issue library plus a benign "no-concern" library, mod-shipped + opt-in community bug DBs, an optional Circinus corpus-prevalence bridge, About.xml incompat + proactive dependency/load-order scan, and a glossary), a global knowledge-base browser, an in-game bug/fix report composer, a suite-styled mod-settings page in parity with the Modules window, a 3-tab dev actions window and reskinned palette, plus impact scoring and updated-mod tracking.
body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony. Open source (MIT).

### Shared UI (`Palette`)
Dark suite chrome, sentence case, ASCII, cached Theme.Accent, flat gray scrollbars. `GameFont.Tiny` is banned suite-wide with one deliberate exception: the dev palette's category line (see Tool 3). Shipped icons in `Textures/UI/DevTools/` via `MdtTex`. `Palette.SearchField`, `Palette.ToggleRow`/`ToggleRowHeight`, `DrawCard`, `SectionHeader`, `DrawToggle`, `GrayButton`, `StateStrip`, `LabelFit`, `BeginScroll`.
- **Text-scaling rule:** never scale text with `GUI.matrix` inside a `Window` — labels render in screen space. Use the three built-in fonts and size rects from `Text.LineHeightOf(font)`.

### Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow`. Left list (culled) + right inspector. Inspector: impact banner (`ImpactAssessor`) → likely source → "What this means" (diagnoses sorted by Score) → module `DrawSection` hooks → report card → stack trace.
- **Auto-open suppression toggle (settings, off by default): `dontAutoOpenAtMainMenu`.**
- **Toolbar B (right→left):** Clear, Copy all, Modules, Update info, Knowledge base, search field.
- **Copy affordances:** toolbar `Copy all` + per-message `Copy message` / `Copy stack trace` / `Copy report`. Vanilla has *no* log-upload button (that's HugsLib's `LogPublisher`; deliberately not cloned — embedded token + dead git.io shortener). `Copy all` only serializes the in-memory list; a file-based "Copy full log" bundle is a considered-but-unbuilt follow-up.

### Impact scoring (`ImpactAssessor`) — location is NOT frequency
- **The rule:** `TickSignals`/`FrameSignals` only prove *where* an error happened; nearly everything runs under `TickManager.DoSingleTick`. **A performance claim requires recurrence (`msg.repeats`), never hot-path frames alone.**
- Thresholds: `RepeatingThreshold = 3`, `SpamThreshold = 10`; `hot = (tick||frame) && repeating`. Critical requires `spam || hot`; one-off error tops at High. Warnings mirror (Moderate needs `spam || hot`, else Low). Perf note only when `repeating`.
- **Curated override:** `ErrorDiagnosis.MaxImpact` (from `KnownIssueDef.maxImpact`) caps the level (`Critical=0 → Info=4`; default Critical = no-op). Capping drops the TPS/FPS note and sets `ImpactResult.Capped`.
- **"Known issue" badge = curated match only:** `ImpactResult.Known` reads `Diagnoses.Any(d => d.FromLibrary)`. `FromLibrary` set **only** by `Module_KnownIssues`, `Module_ModIssues`, `Module_CommunityBugs`.

### Knowledge-base content & factual-provenance convention — AUDITED 2026-08
**Factuality rule: every match string must be a verbatim engine string, verified against decompiled Verse/RimWorld source, with a `source file:line` provenance comment.** A full audit (2026-08, four-lens pass: Harmony cookbook+lore absorption → match-string verification → explanation-semantics verification → diff re-read) verified or fixed **every** entry. ~12 phantom/mispunctuated patterns found and fixed. Trap classes documented in debugging lore: exact punctuation (`TryMakePreToilReservations()` has parens), keyed-translation indirection (mod-list warnings render Core Keyed values: "must be loaded before", NOT "should be"), runtime-native strings not in Assembly-CSharp (`wrapper dynamic-method` = Mono, `Could not load type` = .NET, IMGUI BeginGroup = Unity — marked as such, never fabricated), and messages that don't exist (a missing translation key logs NOTHING; `Translator.Translate` silently falls back).
Unbiased rule: shipped defs never name a third-party mod; `fix` text is always user-actionable. Current inventory:
- **`Defs/KnownIssueDefs.xml` — 44 always-on entries**, all with verbatim provenance comments. Sections: load-time mod metadata (ModMetaData.cs:155–219); exceptions; startup & init (`MDT_StaticConstructor` :25, `MDT_UninitializedDefOf` DefOfHelper:91, `MDT_ConfigErrors`); def/XML data (fixed: `MDT_CrossRef` +"defs of this type loaded" DefDatabase:217; `MDT_DuplicateDef` → "adding duplicate" DefDatabase:79; `MDT_UnknownField` → "corresponds to a field in type" XmlToObjectUtils:89; `MDT_XmlError` +"could not load defs for mod" LoadedModManager:258, dropped "unknown field" false-positive; `MDT_DefInstantiate` rescoped to comp/component family "could not instantiate"; `MDT_MissingTranslation` fully rewritten — real strings are Translator.cs:36/:76/:94 + DefInjectionPackage:506/:560); patches/load-order/save-load (`MDT_Incompatible` fixed to Core Keyed values incl. "requires the following mods to work" + "another active mod uses the same id"); **self-healing vanilla fallbacks — now 4 entries, all `ignorable` + `maxImpact=Low`:** `MDT_RaidArrivalFallback` (IncidentWorker_Raid:57), `MDT_RaidStrategyFallback` (:38 + RaidEnemy:99 "no raid strategy found"), `MDT_PawnGroupFallback` (PawnGroupKindWorker_Normal:54/Shamblers:18 "defaulting to a single random cheap group"), `MDT_WeatherFallback` (WeatherDecider:134); pawn AI/jobs (`MDT_Reservation` fixed to "trymakepretoilreservations() returned false" **with parens** Pawn_JobTracker:379/:937/:948/:958; `MDT_JobLoop` "started 10 jobs in one tick" :274; `MDT_JobException` JobDriver:465/:521/:542); `MDT_HarmonyConflict` **reworded per Harmony execution model** — label now "the error passes through a modified method"; a single mod's patch produces the same `wrapper dynamic-method` frames, so the entry no longer claims "conflict" (that claim needs a patcher count, which `Module_HarmonyPatches` computes: conflict wording only at ≥2 foreign owners); common .NET exceptions; content/quests/UI (`MDT_GuiState` dropped Unity-native "begingroup", kept Text.cs:248/:253 + Widgets.cs:2906).
- **`Defs/BenignLogDefs.xml` — 5 entries, all verified** (Root:97 command line, GenFilePaths:108, Game:495, SavedGameLoaderNow:11, version banner).
- **`Data/community-bugs.json.gz` — 17 entries, audited:** fixed reservation parens, settings ("caught exception while loading mod settings" LoadedModManager:542, dropped unverified "exception in scribe"), pawn render ("error rendering pawn" PawnRenderer:425 + "exception drawing" DynamicDrawManager:229), dropped "no definition for" (compile-time wording, not a runtime log). "getting types in assembly" verified (GenTypes:125, ModAssemblyHandler:61/:77). Workflow: gunzip → edit plain JSON → `gzip -9` back; plain file deleted after (not shipped).
- **Glossary — ~26 terms.** Harmony terms verified against the cookbook corpus; `MDT_GlPrePostfixDef` now notes a prefix can skip the original entirely (common conflict source).

### Benign "no concern" classification
`KnownIssueDef.benign` (in `Defs/BenignLogDefs.xml`). `HasBenignMatch` runs before the module loop (only `msg.type != Error`), sets `ctx.Benign` → attribution suppressed, green badge, impact forced Info, report card hidden. Distinct from `maxImpact` (benign = "normal output, nobody at fault"; maxImpact = "real fallback, just not severe").

### Analysis modules ("What this means") + extensibility
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext`. Per module: `ContributeAttribution` then `Diagnose`, in `def.order`; diagnoses sorted by Score. 13 modules, all defs in flat `Defs/ErrorModules.xml`: StackTrace, LogPrefix, MessageMentions, HarmonyPatches, VersionMismatch, KnownIssues, ModIssues, Community, CommunityBugs, AboutIncompat, DependencyCheck, CircinusCorpus, Glossary.
- **Harmony patch-owner attribution** (`HarmonyIndex` + `Module_HarmonyPatches`): reverse-maps patched methods → owner ids from the live registry. Diagnosis gated: ≥2 foreign patchers (conflict wording, Score 6.5) or Harmony-routed trace (single-patcher wording, Score 4.5). Keyed strings verified accurate vs Harmony execution model (replacement method keeps original name in traces; transpiled code is invisible). Heuristic — never sets `FromLibrary`.
- Index prewarm off-thread; Harmony index lazy. Dependency scan mirrors `GetModWarnings`/`FindConflicts`. Glossary order 900.

### Diagnosis Score scale (house rule)
Single digits: ModIssues 9+(n−i) > CommunityBugs 8+(n−i) > DependencyCheck 8–8.5 > AboutIncompat 7 > Community 6–7 > HarmonyPatches 4.5–6.5 > VersionMismatch 5 > **KnownIssues n−i (lone match = 1;** benign +1000). New context-only modules must score **< 1**.

### Circinus bridge (`Module_CircinusCorpus`, def `MDT_CircinusCorpus`, order 140)
Gated on `requiresPackageId astryl.Circinus`. Reflection-binds `Circinus.KnownIssues` (`Describe`, `ImplicatedMod` — string→string). One-shot probe; loud `WarningOnce` only on contract drift; throw nulls every binding. `Score = 0.5` (below curated floor), `Ignorable`, not `FromLibrary`. Attribution `WeightKnownAttr*0.5 = 2.0` (< WeightMessageName 2.5); fires only at ≥25 affected + ≥25 unaffected runs. Registration + probe verified in-game (run #132, with Circinus as companion). Open item: `ImplicatedMod` not yet in Circinus's frozen-contract doc block (edit handed to user for the Circinus scope).

### Settings surfaces — parity contract
`ModernDevToolsSettings` (all settings) / mod-settings page (`SettingsPage.Draw`, canonical superset: General, Analysis modules, Ignored warnings, Community data, Experimental hardening; measured heights, 16px gutter) / `Dialog_Modules` (quick subset; shares `SourceTag`/`CommunityStatus`). Rule: settings page ⊇ Modules window. Documented in `Documentation/UI-Parity.md`.

### Tool 4: global knowledge base (`Window_KnowledgeBase`)
8 categories, searchable, every entry cites provenance: Sources, Known issues, Benign log lines, Community bugs, Compatibility, Dependencies, Harmony patches (≥2 foreign = amber, capped 300), Glossary.

### Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Off by default; background fetch, cached, offline fallback. RimSort Community Rules + Use This Instead + our known-issues.json at `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues`. Offline snapshot `Data/community-bugs.json.gz`.

### In-game reporting (`ReportBuilder`, `Dialog_Report`)
Server-less; destination: culprit's GitHub → Workshop → community Issue Form. FNV-1a `[#xxxxxxxx]`.

### Tool 2: dev actions window (`Window_ModernDevActions`, 3-tab)
Vanilla `DebugActionNode` graph + "Modern Dev Tools" category (`DebugActions_Testing`, `Anywhere`-gated test actions). Searchable icon-grid spawn pickers; Esc steps up; BFS search; `OpenAt(node)`.

### Tool 3: dev palette (`Window_ModernDevPalette`)
Reskins `Dialog_DevPalette`; resolves pins fresh per frame. `DebugTree` PrettyPrefix/Leaf/Name; two-line rows (`DrawRowText`, Tiny category + Small leaf, `LineOverlap`); auto-fit width 220–640; browser-tab drag-to-reorder (own drag state; never `Event.Use()` on MouseUp; `_swallowClick`); `Patch_DebugActionNodeEnter` keeps submenus in-suite.

### Updated-mod tracking + update notes
`GameComponent_ModSnapshot` → `Dialog_ModChanges`; `Dialog_UpdateNotes` once per Version.

### Experimental hardening
`WindowWatchdog` + `UiHardening`, two toggles, off by default.

### Testing / environment note
Silent crashes during testing traced to **ReShade** (`dxgi.dll`), NOT the mod.

### Localization
`Languages/English/Keyed/ModernDevTools.xml` (`MDT_*`): impact, settings, knowledge-base, glossary (26 pairs incl. `MDT_GlPrePostfix`), Harmony module strings (`MDT_HarmonyConflict*`/`MDT_HarmonyPatched*` — semantics-verified), Circinus (`MDT_CorpusTitle`, `MDT_ReasonCorpusCorrelation`).

## GitHub Backup
MIT. Mod repo: **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools** (PUBLIC). Community bug DB (CC0): **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues** (PUBLIC — the fixed community-bugs entries should be synced there too, pending). `Source/`, `Assemblies/*.dll`, `.modmixer/`, `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` tracked.
